Homebrewery theme attribution
=============================

The files in this directory are vendored from or adapted from the Homebrewery
theme sources supplied from the upstream NaturalCrit/Homebrewery project.
Homebrewery is Copyright (c) 2016 Scott Tolksdorf and is distributed under the
MIT License reproduced in LICENSE.

The included TeX Gyre Pagella font files retain the GUST Font License notice
in fonts/Blank/fonts.less. Copyright 2007-2018 for TeX Gyre extensions by
B. Jackowski, J. M. Nowacki et al. on behalf of TeX Users Groups; Vietnamese
characters were added by Han The Thanh. The fonts may be used and distributed
under the GUST Font License, an instance of the LaTeX Project Public License.

The 5e theme is an unofficial presentation style. Wizards of the Coast owns
the Dungeons & Dragons names, marks, and associated trade dress. BrewVault is
not affiliated with or endorsed by NaturalCrit or Wizards of the Coast.
